scope: Non-donation personal contribution to Nepal flood response and preparedness; international operating practices and selected 55-year historical context
method: Primary government, research and humanitarian sources preferred; original news used for dated eyewitness context. High-consequence comparisons distinguish observed local gaps from nationwide claims.
sourceWordBudget: Generally 200 derived words per source; synthesis workflow and pilot scale are original recommendations, not empirical findings. No extensive verbatim quotation.
unresolved: Ward-specific current unmet needs and receiving partner availability require local verification.
Exact final disaster mechanism and current casualty totals not settled or independently reconciled.
Platform operational performance and live route safety were not tested.
Historical databases are not complete century-wide event inventories.
